The AI question in financial services has moved from which model to use to where that model is allowed to run.

Open models now handle demanding financial work, including multi-step agentic tasks, on hardware a firm can justify. Firms want to run them in their own environment because the most sensitive work can't leave the institution, and because provider, jurisdiction, pricing and security risk are easier to manage there.

Getting a model approved to run inside the firm is the next step. Our COO Kunal Tangri worked through how governance makes that possible with Adrian Lepers and Jeff Boudier of Hugging Face .
